author: _Gill
body:
Hello Staff Team,

Thank you for reading this message, it will be pretty brief. I would like for "DonaldMyTrump" to be banned on all Avicus platforms. Within his post https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/92d6f6db4, he openly admits that he participates in leaking, he has knows people who keylog the staff (allegedly the owner too), and he openly admits to breaking many US laws (such as keylogging and DDOSSing).  

Specific rules he has admitting to breaking include:
A5 - Requesting for a Senior Moderator to leak information
A9 - Ddossing and keylogging
D9 - Creating a public post requesting Moderator and Senior Moderator

US Law:
The Computer Fraud and Abuse Act - Ddossing and Keylogging

Thank you,
Max
